DD1-DD3 IMPLEMENTED (2026-06-05, branch story/588e-abec-221f-42c0/3ebb-resilience-dd123, 5 commits f69247b9..f090ea85, all TDD RED->GREEN, NOT yet landed):

DD1 (tristate gate contract): review-tristate-lib.sh (PASS/FAIL/INDETERMINATE lattice; tristate_classify_verdict, tristate_is_transient_error, tristate_code_to_name) + docs/contracts/review-tristate-lattice.md (review-specific, NOT enforcement-gate-contract.md). Both NAMED gates retrofitted: review-coverage-invariant.sh (errors-only -> INDETERMINATE/75, unreviewed -> FAIL/1) and llm-review-dispatch-or-skip.sh (marker-absent -> INDETERMINATE/75). Tests: tristate-lib 23/23, coverage-invariant 14/14, dispatcher 43/43.

DD2 (durable --resume): INC-008 guard resume_pr_query_trustworthy (partial/failed GitHub read -> INDETERMINATE, never authoritative-empty; wired into the advance-to-PR2 PR1-state read: re-fetch once, else HALT 75). INC-015: resume_staged_ref_is_spent + resume_gc_stale_staged_state (treat /tmp state as CACHE; GC spent/gone staged-* cache) + current-branch assertion (a spent staged-* checkout -> clear 'checkout your feature branch' error + exit 1, NOT fp-recovery — a deterministic operational error, not INDETERMINATE). Tests: resume-inc008 17/17; resume regressions green.

DD3 (universal in-channel escalation): tristate_indeterminate_escalation emits a standardized greppable INDETERMINATE_ESCALATION JSON marker (telemetry-ready) + actionable banner -> /dso:fp-recovery, wired at all 3 INDETERMINATE sites. LAST-RESORT by design (retry-budget-gated; FAIL never escalates) per the maintainer anti-over-reliance review.

SECURITY GUARDRAIL held throughout: INDETERMINATE is always non-zero (blocks under enforce); no resilience path flips a genuine review violation to PASS. NOTE: DD1's 'dangling' gate was listed but the explicitly-NAMED sites were coverage-invariant + llm-review-dispatch (both done). REMAINING: rebase onto current origin/main + land via two-tier; completion-verifier + close.
